verdict.rationale: Salv's own docs refer to scenario versions and describe drafting a flow and backtesting it against historical data before it goes live, which gives a pre-deployment review step. This is a dry-run simulation, not a sandbox deployment. Rollback to a prior version is never documented. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert capability, documented version history and diff/approval workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Run any scenario version against up to a year of your own history, with no real alerts, and see what it would have caught
Draft a flow, run it against your own history with different settings, and see the alerts it would have raised before it goes live.
